records.purpose: Keep independently evolving x and y descriptions attached to one physical object, one declared frame and one shared clock, so only simultaneous component values are recombined into a plane state.

required_physical_semantic_elements.in_words: The horizontal velocity component at the shared physical time.
The vertical velocity component at the same shared physical time.
The one elapsed time used by both component descriptions.

actual_present_elements.caption: Same-time x and y samples may reconstruct one simultaneous particle state; mixed-time samples are non-simultaneous and must be rejected.

representation_correspondence.in_words: The horizontal velocity component at the shared physical time.
The vertical velocity component at the same shared physical time.
The one elapsed time used by both component descriptions.

records.reveal_stage: Rendered only where the canonical scene binding is eligible for the role; Core1B answer-bearing reconstruction remains post-attempt.

records.purpose: Make event selection explicit: one component condition identifies the requested event time, and that same time is then reused on every component before reconstructing the requested state.

required_physical_semantic_elements.in_words: The single elapsed time at which both component descriptions are evaluated for the selected event.
The horizontal displacement evaluated at the shared event time.
The vertical displacement evaluated at the same shared event time.

representation_correspondence.in_words: The single elapsed time at which both component descriptions are evaluated for the selected event.
The horizontal displacement evaluated at the shared event time.
The vertical displacement evaluated at the same shared event time.

records.purpose: Make the ideal projectile specialization conditional on the interactions that remain after release: gravity-only free flight licenses a_x=0 and a_y=-g; retained thrust, significant drag or contact requires a more general model.

required_physical_semantic_elements.in_words: The retained gravitational acceleration magnitude in the ideal projectile specialization.
The horizontal component whose constancy is a consequence of zero horizontal acceleration in the ideal specialization.
The vertical velocity component that changes under the retained gravitational acceleration.
